scope: 576 development size, three saved repeats,432 search/144 reserved audit; no outer test; original refined subsets frozen
matching: Exact cardinality, total cost and number of attributes at each cost value; stricter than cost/cardinality alone
sampling: Uniform independent draws within each cost stratum, retain unique subsets excluding selected subset; fixed seeds; not uniform over all subsets with only matched total cost
empty: One identical empty reference, no substantive comparison
metrics: Raw Brier as in search/audit; all controls evaluated and distribution summarized; no best-control selection
interpretation: Descriptive conditional controls, not an exchangeable permutation test, p-value or significance claim
